name: MyEtherWallet

pricing.notes: MyEtherWallet is free to use. Users pay network gas fees and any third-party provider fee (for example a fiat on-ramp or staking provider fee).

features: Create or import a self-custody wallet
Buy and sell crypto with fiat
Send and receive crypto, tokens and NFTs
ETH staking (partial staking with no minimum, and liquid staking)
Address book and ENS name resolution
WalletConnect, MEW mobile app and Enkrypt extension support

capabilities.name: Swap tokens
capabilities.description: Swap one token for another using aggregated decentralised exchange liquidity.

capabilities.name: Buy and sell crypto
capabilities.description: On-ramp and off-ramp between fiat currency and crypto via integrated payment providers.

capabilities.name: Stake ETH
capabilities.description: Partial staking with no 32 ETH minimum (powered by Coinbase) and liquid staking (powered by Lido). No lock-up period in MEW.

capabilities.name: Trade perpetual futures
capabilities.description: Trade perpetuals directly from a self-custody wallet, 24/7. Unavailable in restricted regions.

capabilities.name: Trade tokenized stocks
capabilities.description: Access tokenized equity exposure onchain, including outside traditional market hours.

capabilities.name: Browse crypto markets
capabilities.description: View token prices, charts and market data without connecting a wallet.

capabilities.name: Verify a signed message
capabilities.description: Verify that a message was signed by a given address.

networks.source: Networks are served dynamically by the MEW API; this list is illustrative, not exhaustive.

custody.keyStorage: client-side, in the user's browser or on a connected hardware wallet

limitations: Requires JavaScript; there is no server-rendered version of the app.
MEW cannot recover or reset a lost recovery phrase.
Perpetuals and some trading features are unavailable in restricted jurisdictions.
Nothing in the app is financial advice.
